title: Haryana: Farmers to start indefinite sit-in outside agriculture minister’s house

ai.summary: Haryana farmers plan indefinite sit-in outside agriculture minister's residence demanding sugarcane prices raised to ₹600 per quintal, citing government payments of ₹430 per quintal after expenses of ₹455.

facts.claim: Haryana farmers plan indefinite sit-in outside agriculture minister's residence
facts.quote: As farmers up the ante over their demand to raise sugarcane prices to ₹600 per quintal, the Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tikait) will begin a permanent dharna (sit-in) in front of the residence of Haryana agriculture and farmers welfare minister Shyam Singh Rana in Radaur town of Yamunanagar district from Saturday.

facts.claim: demanding sugarcane prices raised to ₹600 per quintal
facts.quote: We will begin a permanent day-and-night dharna after erecting a tent, demanding an increase in sugarcane prices. By raising the prices of the crop by only ₹15 per kg, the government has played a cruel joke with the farmers,

facts.claim: government payments of ₹430 per quintal after expenses of ₹455
facts.quote: At a government secret meeting to decide on sugarcane prices, it came to light that the farmers spend ₹455 as expenses incurred on per quintal of crop and we are being paid ₹430.

ai.background_note: Haryana farmers are part of a larger movement demanding higher sugarcane prices, following similar protests in Karnataka where farmers wanted ₹3,500 per tonne after transport costs.
